label: UniFi G5 Dome 2K camera
description: 4 MP (2K) indoor/outdoor dome with two-way audio, 10/100 MbE RJ45 and IK08 impact rating. PoE 802.3af, 5 W max.
notes: PoE class 802.3af, 12.95 W. Wired only. IPX4 only while covered, so it is an indoor/soffit device in practice. Requires a UniFi Protect controller.
